paper_title: SelfHeal: Empirical Fix Pattern Analysis and Bug Repair in LLM Agents
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Combines an empirical study of LLM-agent bug fix patterns with a SelfHeal multi-agent system using a fix agent and critic agent.
task_or_empirical_target: Bug fix pattern analysis and automated repair for LLM-agent bugs.
data_or_benchmark: Stack Overflow, GitHub, HuggingFace Forums, and AgentDefect benchmark.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Very close to AutoEmpirical because it builds an empirical bug taxonomy first, then uses role agents and critic-style validation for automated repair.

paper_title: An Empirical Study of Bugs in Modern LLM Agent Frameworks
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Does not use MAS as the method, but studies bugs in frameworks that enable workflow execution and multi-agent coordination.
task_or_empirical_target: Empirical bug study of LLM agent frameworks.
data_or_benchmark: 998 bug reports from CrewAI and LangChain.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Highly relevant as a comparison dataset/task: symptoms, root causes, lifecycle stages, and agent-specific bug taxonomy resemble AutoEmpirical's labels.

paper_title: Can Large Language Models Serve as Data Analysts? A Multi-Agent Assisted Approach for Qualitative Data Analysis
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Uses 27 LLM-based agents to automate qualitative data analysis steps with human researcher evaluation.
task_or_empirical_target: Qualitative data analysis in software engineering research.
data_or_benchmark: Evaluation by 25 expert researchers against manual analysis outputs.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Most directly answers how others use MAS for empirical study: split summarization, coding, theme extraction, and validation across many agents.

paper_title: OLAF: Towards Robust LLM-Based Annotation Framework in Empirical Software Engineering
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Not a concrete MAS implementation, but formalizes consensus, aggregation, calibration, reliability, drift, and transparency for LLM annotation pipelines.
task_or_empirical_target: LLM-based annotation of commits, issues, and qualitative artifacts in empirical software engineering.
data_or_benchmark: Conceptual framework and methodological position paper.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Important for AutoEmpirical evaluation: treat LLM labels as measurement outputs, report agreement, calibration, drift, prompts, and aggregation policy.

paper_title: LLM-Assisted Empirical Software Engineering: Systematic Literature Review and Research Agenda
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Synthesizes how LLMs are used across empirical software engineering workflows; not limited to MAS.
task_or_empirical_target: Systematic literature review of LLM-assisted empirical software engineering.
data_or_benchmark: 50 peer-reviewed studies from 2020-2025 across 12 SE venues.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Use as umbrella related work: LLMs are concentrated in data processing, classification, filtering, and evaluation, with reproducibility gaps.

how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Frames automated software fault analysis and discusses multi-agent LLM reasoning as an extension for taxonomy synthesis and fault analysis.
task_or_empirical_target: Automatic software fault analysis and empirical fault-study automation.
data_or_benchmark: Software fault analysis artifacts and empirical bug-study context.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: This appears to be the closest direct continuation of your project direction; use it to position MAS as future/next-stage design for fault-taxonomy analysis.

paper_title: Understanding Software Engineering Agents Through the Lens of Traceability: An Empirical Study
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Analyzes execution traces from representative SWE agents to understand decision pathways.
task_or_empirical_target: Agent behavior, bug localization, patch generation, and reproduction test generation.
data_or_benchmark: Five representative SWE agents and generated/developer patch comparisons.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Useful for AutoEmpirical MAS logging: keep per-agent traces so behavior can be audited, not only final labels.

paper_title: An Empirical Study on LLM-based Agents for Automated Bug Fixing
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Compares LLM-based agent and non-agent systems for automated bug fixing.
task_or_empirical_target: Automated bug fixing and agent design factors.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Supports baseline design: compare full MAS to simpler agentless/staged approaches and report localization/reproduction/evidence roles separately.

paper_title: AgentReport: A Multi-Agent LLM Approach for Automated and Reproducible Bug Report Generation
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Uses modular agents such as Data Agent, Prompt Agent, Fine-tuning Agent, Generation Agent, and Evaluation Agent.
task_or_empirical_target: Automated and reproducible bug report generation.
data_or_benchmark: Bugzilla test set and generated report evaluation.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Relevant because it shows how bug-report tasks can be decomposed into data, prompt, generation, and evaluation agents.

paper_title: A Multi-agent LLM System for Automated Requirements Analysis: A Study on User Story Generation and Prioritization
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Uses role-based LLM agents for requirements analysis activities.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Less bug-specific, but useful for role-specialized agents and human-evaluated SE artifacts.

paper_title: Is Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) the Silver Bullet? An Empirical Analysis of MAD in Code Summarization and Translation
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Uses Multi-Agent Debate among LLM agents and evaluates whether debate improves SE tasks.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Good cautionary baseline: MAS protocol itself should be ablated because debate/role interaction may not always outperform simpler workflows.

paper_title: Fully Autonomous Programming using Iterative Multi-Agent Debugging with Large Language Models
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Uses iterative multi-agent debugging in an autonomous programming workflow.
task_or_empirical_target: Programming and debugging with LLM agents.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Useful for AutoEmpirical's Critic/Arbitrator motivation: iterative debugging/critique loops are a common MAS reliability pattern.

paper_title: AgentForge: Execution-Grounded Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Autonomous Software Engineering
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Builds an execution-grounded multi-agent framework for autonomous software engineering.
task_or_empirical_target: Autonomous software engineering with execution feedback.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Relevant as a design comparison: execution grounding and validation should be separated from generation/classification roles.

paper_title: Towards Engineering Multi-Agent LLMs: A Protocol-Driven Approach
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Introduces SEMAP, a protocol-layer methodology with explicit contracts, structured messaging, lifecycle execution, and verification.
task_or_empirical_target: Failure reduction in multi-agent LLM software-engineering tasks.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Useful for AutoEmpirical: define role contracts and message schemas explicitly, then evaluate failure modes.

paper_title: LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems for Software Engineering: Literature Review, Vision and the Road Ahead
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Surveys LLM-based multi-agent systems for software engineering and proposes research agenda.
task_or_empirical_target: Software engineering tasks supported by LLM-based MAS.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Use as broad MAS-in-SE related work before narrowing to empirical bug-study and annotation tasks.

paper_title: ResearchCodeAgent: An LLM Multi-Agent System for Automated Codification of Research Methodologies
how_mas_or_agents_are_used: Uses a multi-agent system to implement research methodologies described in ML papers.
key_takeaway_for_autoempirical: Useful broader auto-research baseline: agents operationalize paper methods, reducing manual implementation time.
